topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The metal beast was gone, leaving a cold, empty space. Tracks of its departure marred the ground, a stark reminder of its sudden absence. The air, once filled with the familiar hum, now carries an unsettling silence. Shadows loom larger, every tiny rustle and movement feels exaggerated, as if the world itself is watching, waiting. I move through the familiar space, each step cautious, eyes and ears straining for any sign of what might come next. The world feels different, less certain, with the absence of the metal beast. I cannot shake the sense of exposure, of being open to unseen dangers.
